scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONT,BACK,WORKER,URLS -c cyan,magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:worker" "node scripts/dev-urls.mjs"
scripts.dev:back: cd backend && poetry run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && poetry run celery -A app.tasks.process_ticket worker -I app.tasks.scrape_promos,app.tasks.discover_promos --pool=solo --loglevel=info
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n FRONT,BACK,WORKER,NGROK,URLS -c cyan,magenta,blue,yellow,green "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:worker" "ngrok http 3000 --url=${NGROK_URL:-tarot-friction-barbell.ngrok-free.dev}" "node scripts/dev-urls.mjs --ngrok"
